games.title: League of Legends: New Dawn Unveiled With Debut Trailer, Riot Announces Major Overhaul Coming in 2027
games.summary: At the 2026 League of Legends World Championship Finals, Riot Games officially unveiled League of Legends: New Dawn. The large-scale update is scheduled for 2027 and will bring changes to the game's client, Summoner's Rift, visuals, and gameplay, marking the beginning of a new chapter for one of the industry's most enduring titles.

games.title: Rumour: Rainbow Six: Vegas 3 Now in the Works at Ubisoft
games.summary: 18 years on from Vegas 2. Ubisoft has just greenlit and entered the early stages of development on a third Rainbow Six: Vegas game, according to a new Insider Gaming report . The outlet, which seems to have been clued up on internal Ubisoft happenings for years, claims the new entry is one of three projects that have just started production at Ubisoft Montreal, and one of the other two is also set in the Rainbow Six universe.
